description: Analyze, summarize, extract, and explain PDF documents with source-aware answers.

defaultPrompt: Summarize this PDF in five key points.
Find the evidence for this claim in the PDF.
Extract the tables and explain their meaning.
interface.longDescription: AI PDF Assistant reads supplied PDF files, identifies their structure, answers questions, summarizes sections, extracts tables and key fields, and clearly distinguishes document evidence from inference. It asks for the relevant file or page when the request is underspecified and never invents content that is absent from the PDF. Customer support: https://thedoersfirm.com/support.
interface.shortDescription: Extract PDFs and cite the docs

name: ai-pdf-assistant
